description: Bot hit counts per (day, bot category, bot label, status code, content-type bucket) across every log upload in the date range — powers a time-series, status-code, or content-type view of bot traffic. Rows are `{ day, botCategory, botLabel, statusCode, contentType, hitCount }`; botCategory is ai_crawler/search_engine/other_bot. Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD), UTC. An empty result means nothing was measured in the range — no bot hits were recorded from the logs uploaded for those days, which is not the same as no bots visiting. FREE (no credits).

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

sinceDay.description: Inclusive start day, ISO date, UTC.

untilDay.description: Inclusive end day, ISO date, UTC.

name: log_analyzer_daily_summary
